analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see stance for the past 3 trading days. RSI declined from 62.9 to 54.4, continuing sideways movement in the neutral zone. MACD histogram worsened from 1.1950 to -0.6075, signaling a potential shift to weakness. ADX at 19.3 indicates a non-trending phase. The 5-day high < 20-day high * 0.995 pattern formed a Lower High. With volatility ATR at $7.25, setting a stop loss at 1.3x ATR ($9.425) and target at 2.6x ATR ($18.85) would imply an entry at $333.02, stop at $323.60, and target at $351.87. However, due to the lack of trend and MACD deterioration, a buy entry is postponed.
